topics.topic: Identity treatment of imported records recreated after restoring a pre-import backup
questions: When the lost changes include an import, does the repeated import keep the original v1 project, room and pointer ids while minting only new `customer_ref`s, or does it mint new identities for every imported record?
Does “first made after the backup” cover records introduced into the lost store by the import, or only records originally created there through ordinary create, record, add and publish actions?

quotes: It keeps every identity and link: project ids, `customer_ref`s, room and pointer ids and versions.

Projects, Customers, rooms and pointers first made after the backup are
made again by the ordinary actions, with new identities;
judgement.why: The import keeps imported project, room and pointer identities, while R0-89 says records first made after the backup are recreated with new identities without excluding records introduced by the lost import.

topics.topic: Where the repeated post-restore anonymisation instant is recorded
questions: After anonymisation is repeated following a restore, does the Project itself carry the repetition instant, or is that instant held only by the new audit entry?
After repeating an anonymisation following restore, does the Project retain the repetition instant with its anonymised mark, or does only the new audit entry retain that instant?

quotes:
ended relationship that recorded end date again; every other mark carries
the instant of its repetition.

An anonymised project is a Project with status `archived` and the anonymised
mark: it keeps its `project_id`, its status, that mark and its artifact
pointers (M05) and nothing else (R0-62, R0-87) — name, alias, object, customer link,
rooms, revision, the request id of its create and every instant are gone;
judgement.why: R0-89 assigns the repetition instant to every other repeated mark, but M01 says the anonymised mark survives while every instant is removed from the Project.

topics.topic: AgentSession and access-state reconciliation after backup restore
questions: After a restore, are AgentSession records and access facts taken from the backup as still live, ended and re-registered by Kernel, or reconciled through owner actions—and what happens to sessions and access changes first made after that backup?

topics.topic: Handling post-backup records that cannot be reconstructed from available facts
questions: What happens when a post-backup Project, Customer, Room or ArtifactPointer cannot be recreated because the owner no longer has the facts required by its ordinary creation action?

topics.topic: How archived status is restored before repeating project erasure
questions: Which product action or recorded fact restores the required archived state before the owner repeats an archived-project erasure?
